jobs.title: Werkstudent Controlling und Datenanalyse (w/m/x)
jobs.start_info: Startdatum: ab frühestens 26.10.2026 | Dauer: 12 Monate | Arbeitszeit: Teilzeit
jobs.description_text:
[intro] Unser Team bei der BMW M GmbH gestaltet datengetriebene Steuerungs- und Analyseprozesse und schafft Transparenz für fundierte betriebswirtschaftliche Entscheidungen. Wir verbinden Controlling-Kompetenz mit moderner Datenanalyse und Business Intelligence. Im Rahmen deines Werkstudiums lernst du, wie beides wirkungsvoll zusammenwirkt.

[Was erwartet dich?] Du unterstützt ein Digitalisierungsprojekt im Projektcontrolling der BMW M GmbH und trägst zur Weiterentwicklung datenbasierter Controlling- und Steuerungslösungen bei. • Außerdem unterstützt du bei der Strukturierung und Harmonisierung von Datenquellen sowie der Weiterentwicklung belastbarer Datenmodelle. • Darüber hinaus unterstützt du bei der Nutzung von Datenbanken und der Erstellung von Abfragen zur Gewinnung und Aufbereitung relevanter Daten. • Zudem wirkst du mit bei der Analyse von Daten mithilfe moderner BI-Tools und leitest relevante Erkenntnisse ab. • Außerdem unterstützt du bei der zielgruppengerechten Visualisierung von Ergebnissen und trägst so zu mehr Transparenz für fundierte betriebswirtschaftliche Entscheidungen bei. •

[Was bringst du mit?] Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Informatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs mit betriebswirtschaftlicher, datenanalytischer oder technischer Ausrichtung. • Erste praktische Erfahrungen in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Controlling oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld. • Kenntnisse im Umgang mit BI-Tools, idealerweise Power BI. • Erfahrung in der Datenaufbereitung, Datenanalyse und Datenvisualisierung. • Grundkenntnisse in der Strukturierung und Modellierung von Daten sowie der Harmonisierung von Datenquellen. • Praktische Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Datenbanken, SQL und der Erstellung von Abfragen. • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. • Möchtest du Controlling und Datenanalyse bei der BMW M GmbH wirkungsvoll verbinden und datenbasierte Entscheidungen aktiv unterstützen? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!

[Was bieten wir dir?] Umfassendes Mentoring & Onboarding. • Persönliche & fachliche Weiterentwicklung. • Flexible Arbeitszeiten. • Mobilarbeit. • Attraktive & faire Vergütung. • Apartments für Studierende (nach Verfügbarkeit & nur am Standort München). • Und vieles mehr siehe bmw.jobs/waswirbieten •

jobs.title: Intern Artificial Intelligence in Robotics (f/m/x)
jobs.description_text:
[intro] Physical AI is fundamentally transforming automation. Our team at the BMW Group applies cutting-edge breakthroughs in robot learning to automate complex assembly tasks directly on the factory line. During your internship, you support us in a fast-paced environment with state-of-the-art hardware and exciting innovation projects.

[What awaits you?] You support applied research in Embodied AI for automating assembly tasks. • Furthermore, you help develop architectures and algorithms for robot learning. • In addition, you contribute to evaluating and testing approaches on state-of-the-art robotic hardware. • Moreover, you assist in exciting innovation projects in industrial robotics. • Furthermore, you support the collaboration within a small, motivated team in a fast-paced environment. •

[What should you bring along?] Studies in robotics, computer science, electrical engineering or a related field. • Experience with Python, ROS and PyTorch. • Technical foundations in reinforcement learning, behavior cloning, deep learning, robot task planning, MDPs, MPC or teleoperation. • Practical knowledge of simulation environments such as Isaac Sim or MuJoCo. • Hands-on experience working with real or simulated manipulators. • Contributions to scientific publications are a plus. • Good German and English skills. • Would you like to help shape the future of industrial robotics through cutting-edge AI research? Then Apply now!

[What do we offer?] Comprehensive mentoring & onboarding. • Personal & professional development. • Flexible working hours. • Mobile work. • Attractive & fair compensation. • Apartments for students (subject to availability & only at the Munich location). • And much more, see bmw.jobs/waswirbieten •

[Duration] 6 months

[Working hours] Full-time You can find helpful tips on your application and the application process here . At the BMW Group, we place great importance on equal treatment and equal opportunities. jobs.title: Thesis AI Assisted Fault Injection (f/m/x)
jobs.description_text:
[intro] In our Penetration Testing team, which is part of the Automotive Cyber Security department, we search for vulnerabilities in Electronic Control Units (ECUs) and embedded microcontrollers. As the software on ECUs continues to become more secure, hardware attacks are gaining popularity in the automotive hacking scene. In your Master’s Thesis, you will perform fault injection attacks on microcontrollers, as well as evaluate countermeasures and suggest improvements to protect future control units from such attacks.

[What can you expect?] You will assist in evaluating microcontroller platforms regarding fault injection susceptibility. • You will implement examples of sensitive use cases (e.g., password comparison, signature verification) in C/C++. • You will analyze the timing of successful attacks on assembly level and use the data to create fault models. • You will use a Large Language Model to optimize searching the attack parameter space. •

[What do you bring?] Studying Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Cyber Security, or a comparable field. • Solid programming skills in C/C++, along with basic knowledge of ARM assembly. • Knowledge of Python, bash, or another scripting language. • Basic understanding of implementing cryptographic algorithms. • Experience using Agentic AI tools. • Experience with side-channel or fault attack techniques. • You are enthused by new technologies and an innovative environment? Apply now!

jobs.title: Thesis Causal ML for Prescriptive Decision Support in Automotive Goodwill (f/m/x)
jobs.description_text:
[intro] Our team at the BMW Group focuses on the data-driven optimization of goodwill decisions. We rely on Causal Machine Learning and Uplift Modeling to enhance customer satisfaction, loyalty, and budget efficiency. As part of your internship, you will support us in developing new analytical methods.

[What awaits you?] You will support the literature review on state-of-the-art methods in Causal Machine Learning, Uplift Modeling, and causal inference. • Furthermore, you help analyze available goodwill, customer, vehicle, and loyalty data. • In addition, you support the development of a causal DAG and the identification of confounders such as vehicle model, service dealer, and customer history. • Moreover, you will assist in developing and comparing Causal ML methods such as Meta-Learners, Causal Forests, Double Machine Learning, and Uplift Models. • Furthermore, you contribute to evaluating treatment effect estimates and resulting goodwill allocation policies. • In addition, you support the analysis of heterogeneous treatment effects across customer, vehicle, and repair segments. • Moreover, you help develop a decision-support framework for optimizing goodwill allocation. •

[What should you bring along?] Studies in (business) informatics, data science, statistics, (business) mathematics or a related field. • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. • Experience with Python and common machine learning libraries. • Solid knowledge of statistics and machine learning. • Interest in Causal ML, experimentation, and data-driven decision-making. • Good German and English skills. • Would you like to help shape goodwill decisions in a data-driven and impactful way using Causal Machine Learning? Then Apply now!

jobs.description_text:
[intro] At BMW Motorrad, interns gain hands-on experience from day one and are encouraged to contribute ideas and take initiative. You will support our team as a valued member, developing practical skills and making a real impact. This internship offers broad insights into Sales, Marketing, After Sales, Dealer Development, and Product Management across North and South America. You will help plan, coordinate, and execute diverse activities, gaining a comprehensive view of our business.

[What awaits you?] You will support the BMW Motorrad team in the sales coordination office for the Americas region during your internship. • Furthermore, you help to develop regional sales reporting, consolidate financial and sales data, coordinate market analyses and competitor benchmarks, and prepare presentations for management. • In addition, you contribute to supporting Sales, After Sales, Marketing and Dealer Development Area Managers in day-to-day business and projects such as market strategies or new business areas. • Moreover, you will assist in organizing meetings, business trips and company events, and maintain direct contact with process partners in marketing, finance, business development and customer care. • Chance to access our internal fleet and have product experience. •

jobs.title: Thesis Autonomous Driving Simulation and Representation Learning
jobs.description_text:
[intro] Our team at the BMW Group focuses on next-generation end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving systems and simulation technologies. We concentrate on learning robust, high-level internal representations that enable realistic and scalable simulation as well as data-efficient model development. As an intern, you support the investigation of how synthetic data from driving simulators can improve these representations and make them more applicable to real-world data.

[What awaits you?] You support the exploration and implementation of methods for learning and improving high-level feature representations in E2E autonomous driving models. • Furthermore, you help design and execute experiments using synthetic driving data (e.g., from CARLA) with flexible combinations of perception inputs and scene descriptions. • In addition, you contribute to researching approaches such as representation learning, multi-modal learning, and sim-to-real transfer to improve model performance. • Moreover, you support defining and evaluating suitable metrics and protocols to assess the quality of the learned representations. • Furthermore, you help analyze experimental results, refine training pipelines, and contribute ideas to improve scalability. • In addition, you support documenting your findings scientifically and presenting results to an interdisciplinary team. •

Then Apply now!

jobs.title: Working Student Position Exterior Crash Simulation (f/m/x)
jobs.description_text:
[intro] Our team at the BMW Group develops detailed finite element models for accurate predictions of crash load cases in vehicle development. We continuously improve modelling guidelines and automate pre- and postprocessing processes for exterior crash load cases such as pedestrian protection and bumper-to-bumper collisions. As part of your working student position, you support us with scripting and testing of models and processes.

[What awaits you?] You will support the development of pre- and postprocessing tools for simulation data. • Furthermore, you help evaluate and develop new modelling approaches for crash simulations. • In addition, you support the development of data mining applications to analyze simulation results. • Moreover, you help test models and processes for exterior crash load cases such as pedestrian protection and bumper-to-bumper collisions. •

[What should you bring along?] Studies in mechanical engineering, automotive engineering, aerospace engineering or a comparable field. • In-depth knowledge of the finite element method. • Programming skills in Python and shell scripting. • High self-motivation and strong team spirit. • Good command of German and/or English. • Would you like to apply your finite element expertise and help shape crash simulation at the BMW Group? Then Apply now!

[What do we offer?] Comprehensive mentoring & onboarding. • Personal & professional development. • Flexible working hours. • Mobile work. • Attractive & fair compensation. • Apartments for students (subject to availability & only at the Munich location). • And much more, see bmw.jobs/waswirbieten •

jobs.title: Intern Software Engineering with Artificial Intelligence (f/m/x)
jobs.description_text:
[intro] Our team at the BMW Group develops intelligent software engineering solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs) for automated code understanding, knowledge retrieval, and generation of software development artifacts. We connect enterprise software development workflows with AI technologies to improve efficiency in requirements engineering, code analysis, and developer assistance.

[What awaits you?] You support the development and enhancement of LLM-based applications for software engineering workflows. • Furthermore, you support building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines by embedding codebases and retrieving relevant code context via semantic search. • In addition, you help integrate enterprise tools such as Jira and CodeBeamer with AI-based workflows. • Moreover, you support designing and evaluating prompt engineering approaches for generating artifacts such as requirements, implementation recommendations, and technical building blocks. • Furthermore, you help investigate and compare state-of-the-art LLMs for industrial software development applications. • In addition, you contribute to developing methods that improve the accuracy, reliability, and traceability of AI-generated engineering outputs. • Moreover, you support evaluating generated artifacts against software engineering quality criteria. •

[What should you bring along?] Studies in computer science, artificial intelligence, software engineering, or a related field. • Very good programming skills in Python. • Basic knowledge of LLMs, RAG, embeddings, and prompt engineering. • Experience with software development workflows and version control systems such as Git. • Familiarity with APIs, databases, and integrating AI models into applications. • Strong analytical skills, interest in applying AI techniques to real-world engineering problems, and knowledge of requirements engineering or automotive software development is advantageous. • Good German and English language skills. • Would you like to help shape intelligent AI-driven software engineering solutions while learning something new? Then Apply now!

[What do we offer?] Comprehensive mentoring & onboarding. • Personal & professional development. • Flexible working hours. • Mobile work. • Attractive & fair compensation. • Apartments for students (subject to availability & only at the Munich location). • And much more, see bmw.jobs/waswirbieten •

[Start date] Earliest start date 19.10.2026

[Duration] 6 months

[Working hours] Full-time You can find helpful tips on your application and the application process here . At the BMW Group, we place great importance on equal treatment and equal opportunities. Our recruiting decisions are based on the personality, experience, and skills of the applicants. Learn more here .

Im Rahmen deines Werkstudiums unterstützt du unser Team bei Data Science und Front-End-Entwicklung.

jobs.title: Praktikant Konzernrevision Financial Services (w/m/x)
jobs.start_info: Startdatum: ab frühestens 07.01.2027 | Dauer: 3 bis 6 Monate | Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit
jobs.description_text:
[intro] Unser Team der Konzernrevision Financial Services bei der BMW Group prüft das Finanzierungs- und Leasinggeschäft unserer europäischen Financial Services Gesellschaften in den Bereichen Kredit- und Risikomanagement, Governance, Compliance, Finanzen, Operations und Vertrieb. Als prozessunabhängige Einheit beurteilen wir potenzielle Risiken für die Geschäftstätigkeit der BMW Group und unterstützen den Vorstand durch objektive Prüfungen. In deinem Praktikum wirkst du aktiv an diesen Prüfungen mit und sammelst wertvolle Einblicke in die Interne Revision.

[Was erwartet dich?] Du bist Teil des Financial Services Audit Teams und unterstützt bei der Analyse und Bewertung von Geschäftsprozessen und -strukturen der europäischen Financial Services Gesellschaften. • Außerdem unterstützt du bei der Prüfung der Governance, der Beherrschung von Geschäftsrisiken, des internen Kontrollsystems sowie der rechtlichen und regulatorischen Anforderungen. • Darüber hinaus wirkst du bei analytischen und datenbasierten Untersuchungen mit, um Risikofelder mit Konzernrelevanz zu identifizieren und die Prüfungsteams bei Berichten zu unterstützen. • Zudem erhältst du in einem dynamischen Arbeitsumfeld spannende Einblicke in die Interne Revision. •

[Was bringst du mit?] Studium der Wirtschafts- oder Rechtswissenschaften, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen, Bankwesen, Wirtschaftsrecht, Regulatorik oder Compliance, oder vergleichbarer Studiengang. • Erfahrungen aus Berufsausbildungen, Praktika oder Werkstudententätigkeiten, idealerweise in Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften, Unternehmensberatungen oder der Internen Revision, sind von Vorteil. • Gewissenhaftigkeit, schnelle Auffassungsgabe, analytisches Vorgehen sowie eine strategische und koordinierte Vorgehensweise runden das Profil ab. • Routinierter Umgang mit MS Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel, sowie Interesse an AI, Data Science und IT-Systemen zur Datenanalyse. • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. • Hast du Lust, die Konzernrevision Financial Services tatkräftig zu unterstützen und dabei Neues zu lernen? jobs.start_info: Startdatum: ab frühestens 05.10.2026 | Dauer: 12 Monate | Arbeitszeit: Teilzeit
jobs.description_text:
[intro] Unser Team verantwortet die Software-Integration ins Fahrzeug und stellt sicher, dass komplexe Softwarestände verschiedener Fachbereiche sauber zusammengeführt, abgesichert und für das Gesamtfahrzeug verfügbar gemacht werden. jobs.title: Thesis Machine Learning for Automated Driving (f/m/x)
jobs.description_text:
[intro] Our team at the BMW Group develops new approaches for scalable data collection in automated driving. We focus on compact, multi-modal trigger models that reliably and precisely detect relevant driving situations. As part of your thesis, you support our team in developing and optimizing these models.

[What awaits you?] You will support the review and assessment of multi-modal approaches for scenario and concept detection, including CLIP, VideoCLIP, and BLIP. • Furthermore, you help formalize the task as a multi-label, multi-modal, temporal classification problem using image, object, and location data. • In addition, you support the definition of labeling requirements for a growing set of scenario concepts. • Moreover, you assist in designing a compact, multi-modal fusion architecture for processing multiple sensor data streams. • Furthermore, you help apply model optimization techniques such as knowledge distillation, quantization, and pruning. • In addition, you contribute to building the training and evaluation pipeline and defining suitable evaluation metrics. • Moreover, you support the assessment of onboard feasibility regarding runtime and memory footprint. •

[What should you bring along?] Studies in computer science, electrical engineering, robotics, data science, or a related field • Strong foundation in machine learning and deep learning, ideally with experience in computer vision or multi-modal learning • Proficient in Python and experienced with common ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow • In-depth knowledge of model optimization techniques such as quantization, pruning, or distillation as well as experience with sequence models such as transformers is a plus • Interest in automated driving, sensor fusion, and embedded or edge ML deployment • Structured and precise working approach along with strong team spirit • Very good English skills; German skills are a plus • Would you like to help shape compact, multi-modal AI models for automated driving? Then Apply now!

[What do we offer?] Comprehensive mentoring & onboarding. • Personal & professional development. • Flexible working hours. • Mobile work. • Attractive & fair compensation. • Apartments for students (subject to availability & only at the Munich location). • And much more, see bmw.jobs/waswirbieten •

[Start date] Earliest start date 10/01/2026

[Duration] 6 months

[Working hours] Full-time You can find helpful tips on your application and the application process here . At the BMW Group, we place great importance on equal treatment and equal opportunities. Our recruiting decisions are based on the personality, experience, and skills of the applicants. Learn more here .

jobs.title: Intern FinOps for AI & Tokenomics (f/m/x)
jobs.description_text:
[intro] As the FinOps Center of Excellence at the BMW Group, we own the FinOps strategy and support its decentralized implementation across the company. With the topics FinOps for AI, Tokenomics, and the economic management of AI services, we continuously develop our service portfolio. As part of your internship, you support us with organizational and technical tasks in the FinOps environment and gain exciting insights into the future of cost management, FinOps governance, and technology enablement.

[What awaits you?] You support the FinOps Center of Excellence in advancing the topics FinOps for Cloud and AI, Tokenomics, and AI Cost Transparency. • Furthermore, you help create and prepare reports, analyses, presentations, and communication materials for various stakeholders. • In addition, you support the planning, organization, and execution of workshops, community events, trainings, and communication campaigns. • Moreover, you help maintain and further develop our knowledge base, documentation, best practices, and enablement materials. • Furthermore, you help analyze usage and cost data in the cloud and AI environment. • In addition, you closely engage with our international team of FinOps experts and receive comprehensive onboarding into all relevant topics. •

[What should you bring along?] Studies in business informatics, computer science, economics, data science or a comparable field. • Interest in the topics FinOps, cloud, artificial intelligence as well as cost management and digitalization. • Basic knowledge of SQL, Python, Java, HTML or other scripting languages as well as public cloud (AWS and Azure) is desirable. • Strong communication skills as well as enthusiasm for community engagement, knowledge sharing, and collaboration in interdisciplinary teams. • Initial experience in data analysis as well as with Excel, Amazon QuickSight or comparable tools is an advantage. • Proactive, structured, and reliable approach. • Very good German and English skills, written and spoken. • Would you like to actively shape the future of FinOps for AI and Tokenomics and gain valuable hands-on experience? Then Apply now!

[What do we offer?] Comprehensive mentoring & onboarding. • Personal & professional development. • Flexible working hours. • Mobile work. • Attractive & fair compensation. • Apartments for students (subject to availability & only at the Munich location). • And much more, see bmw.jobs/waswirbieten •

Im Rahmen deines Werkstudiums unterstützt du ein interdisziplinäres Team bei der Weiterentwicklung digitaler Lösungen zur Absicherung des BMW Dynamic Performance Control. Ziel ist es, technische Prozesse softwareseitig zu unterstützen, weiterzuentwickeln und perspektivisch zu automatisieren.

[Was erwartet dich?] Du unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung eines internen digitalen Werkzeugs und bringst dich entlang des gesamten Entwicklungsprozesses ein, von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung. • Außerdem wirkst du an verschiedenen Aspekten der Anwendung mit und unterstützt bei der Realisierung neuer Funktionen und technischer Konzepte. • Darüber hinaus analysierst du reale technische Prozesse und datenbasierte Anforderungen und überführst sie in geeignete Softwarelösungen. • Zudem bringst du dich in einem agilen Prototypen-Umfeld ein und unterstützt die iterative Entwicklung, Umsetzung und Verfeinerung von Ideen. • Außerdem pflegst du den fachlichen Austausch mit Entwickler:innen, Ingenieur:innen und weiteren Studierenden. •

jobs.title: Intern MINI Customer Journey Management and Digital Marketing (f/m/x)
jobs.description_text:
[intro] Our team at the BMW Group shapes the customer journey for MINI through digital marketing, social media, and e-commerce initiatives. During your time as an intern, you contribute to international brand communication and help connect customers across multiple digital touchpoints.

[What awaits you?] You support the digital activation and development of marketing concepts. • Furthermore, you help focus on the overall international customer journey touchpoints. • In addition, you support the conception, development, coordination, and introduction of specific digital brand communication measures and product launches. • Moreover, you support the conception, development, and coordination of relevant omni-channel marketing projects. • Furthermore, you help implement and evaluate relevant strategic market analyses and KPI reports. • In addition, you support the coordination of smaller marketing projects, especially for the European region. • Moreover, you support operational tasks such as workshop preparations, creating presentations, and coordinating with agencies. •

[What should you bring along?] Studies in business administration, marketing, communications or a related field • General affinity for marketing and first practical experience in digital marketing • Interest in digital marketing topics including social media and e-commerce • Ability to adapt in a multicultural and dynamic team • Creative, structured, and proactive approach to assigned tasks • Very good knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint • Good English skills; German language skills are a plus • Would you like to help shape MINI's customer journey and grow within an international marketing team? Then Apply now!

[What do we offer?] Comprehensive mentoring & onboarding. • Personal & professional development. • Flexible working hours. • Mobile work. • Attractive & fair compensation. • Apartments for students (subject to availability & only at the Munich location). • And much more, see bmw.jobs/waswirbieten •

[Start date] Earliest start date 10/01/2026

[Duration] 6 months

[Working hours] Full-time You can find helpful tips on your application and the application process here . We at the BMW Group place great importance on equal treatment and equal opportunities. Our recruiting decisions are based on the personality, experiences, and skills of the applicants. More about this here .

jobs.title: Bachelor's Thesis: AI-Assisted Software Development (f/m/x)
jobs.description_text:
[intro] Our team within BMW Group Idea Management continuously develops digital solutions to support innovation and continuous improvement processes. As part of this bachelor's thesis, we support you in exploring and developing modern AI-assisted software engineering methods to create an innovative IT tool for idea management.

[What awaits you?] You support the analysis of existing processes and systems within the idea management environment. • Furthermore, you help design an AI-based software development approach for a new IT solution. • In addition, you support the use of Generative AI and AI coding assistants to develop software components. • Moreover, you contribute to developing a prototype web-based and/or database-driven system for idea management. • Furthermore, you help integrate data sources, interfaces, and reporting functionalities. • In addition, you support the evaluation of opportunities and limitations of AI-assisted software development in an industrial environment. • Moreover, you help document, scientifically assess, and present the project results. •

[What should you bring along?] Studies in computer science, business informatics, data science, or a comparable field. • Knowledge of at least one programming language, such as JavaScript, Python, or Java. • First experience in web development and/or database development. • Interest in artificial intelligence, Generative AI, and modern software engineering methodologies. • Strong analytical thinking and a structured working method. • Enthusiasm for solving complex challenges and a proactive mindset. • Very good German and/or English language skills. • Are you passionate about new technologies, Generative AI, and innovative software engineering environments? Then Apply now!

[What do we offer?] Comprehensive mentoring & onboarding. • Personal & professional development. • Flexible working hours. • Mobile work. • Attractive & fair compensation. • Apartments for students (subject to availability & only at the Munich location). • And much more, see bmw.jobs/whatweoffer •

[Start date] Earliest start date 12.10.2026

[Duration] 6 months

[Working hours] Full-time You can find helpful tips on your application and the application process here . At the BMW Group, we place great importance on equal treatment and equal opportunities. Our recruiting decisions are based on the personality, experience, and skills of the applicants. Learn more here . Please note that you are responsible for ensuring that your final thesis is supervised by a college or university.

jobs.title: Working Student or Internship Automotive Cyber Security (f/m/x)
jobs.description_text:
[intro] Our team at the BMW Group develops secure platforms for innovative Linux and Android-based ECUs. You will support us in creating security-critical components and applying your theoretical knowledge in a real-world environment. This position is offered as working student position or as a mandatory internship that is required by a University or Hochschule.

[What awaits you?] You will help design and implement automated security system tests in our Python-based integration testing framework. • Furthermore, you contribute to our Yocto-based integration toolchain. • In addition, you support improving system configuration from a security perspective by providing reviews and suggestions. • Moreover, you assist other developers to understand basic and advanced security concepts such as POSIX permissions, seccomp filters or SELinux. • You will also help to write and debug C++ library and service code for our ARM-based ECUs. • Additionally, you gain hands-on experience with AI coding assistant tools and explore their benefits and limitations. •

[What should you bring along?] Studies in computer science, software engineering or a related field. • Experience working with Linux on the terminal. • Basic understanding of Linux security features. • Experience with Python. • Experience with C++ and/or Rust is helpful but not mandatory. • Understanding of distro building and Yocto is appreciated but not expected. • Good English skills. • The position is only offered onsite at BMW Car IT in Ulm. Remote work ist not possible. Required is enrollment at a German University or Hochschule. Are you excited by new technologies and an innovative environment? Then Apply now!

[What do we offer?] Comprehensive mentoring & onboarding. • Personal & professional development. • Flexible working hours. • Attractive & fair compensation. • And much more, see bmw.jobs/whatweoffer •

[Start date] earliest start 01.10.2026

[Duration] 6 months

[Working hours] Part-time You can find helpful tips on your application and the application process here . At the BMW Group, we place great importance on equal treatment and equal opportunities. jobs.title: Intern: AI Engineer for Agentic Applications (f/m/x)
jobs.description_text:
[intro] Our team at BMW Group IT brings the latest Data Science and Generative AI technologies to the BMW Group. We explore new application areas and develop industrial use cases across all divisions, including business applications and IT processes. During your internship, you will contribute to the development and industrialization of agentic applications that accelerate and optimize digitalization at the BMW Group.

[What awaits you?] You will support our professional, experienced, and international AI team in developing cutting-edge agentic applications. • Furthermore, you help to develop features for agentic applications in IT and business use cases. • In addition, you assist in exploring and implementing the latest agentic and Generative AI algorithms, protocols, and techniques to optimize business-relevant metrics. • Moreover, you contribute to researching the latest developments in the agentic and Generative AI space. • You will also help implement relevant techniques and protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent-to-Agent (A2A), and Agent-to-UI protocols. •

[What should you bring along?] Studies in computer science, electrical engineering or a related technical field. • Strong coding experience in Python (mandatory); experience with frontend engineering frameworks such as Angular is advantageous. • Previous experience in building agentic applications (mandatory). • Experience with Generative AI and agentic protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent-to-Agent (A2A), and Agent-to-UI (AG-UI) protocols is highly desired. • Experience with LLM and Agentic AI SDK frameworks such as Langchain, Langgraph, CrewAI, PydanticAI, and OpenAI Agents SDK is highly desired. • Knowledge about agent harnesses and long-running agents; experience with cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Azure is beneficial. • The internship requires onsite presence in Munich; fluent English skills, German beneficial. • Would you like to shape the future of AI-driven digitalization at the BMW Group and gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge agentic technologies? Then Apply now!

[What do we offer?] Comprehensive mentoring & onboarding. • Personal & professional development. • Flexible working hours. • Mobile work. • Attractive & fair compensation. • Apartments for students (subject to availability & only at the Munich location). • And much more, see bmw.jobs/whatweoffer •

Der Fokus liegt auf anwendbarer Methodik, leichter Nutzbarkeit der Tools und einem durchgängigen Datenmanagement inklusive Zugänglichkeit für KI-basierte Anwendungen.

Informatik oder vergleichbar. • Affinität zum Programmieren und zur Softwareentwicklung, insbesondere Java. • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office, PowerPoint und Excel. • Kenntnisse der Agile Toolchain wie Jira und Confluence sind von Vorteil. • Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit. • Begeisterung für neue Technologien und ein innovatives Umfeld. • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und möglichst gute Englischkenntnisse. • Möchtest du unser Team bei der toolseitigen Umsetzung moderner Anforderungsentwicklung unterstützen? jobs.start_info: Startdatum: frühestens ab 01.09.2026 | Dauer: 12 Monate | Arbeitszeit: Teilzeit
jobs.description_text:
[intro] Unser Team bei der BMW Group treibt die Entwicklung der IT-Infrastruktur zwischen Backoffice in München und Rennstrecke voran. Du unterstützt uns bei der Konzipierung, Umsetzung und Optimierung von Toolchains und IT-Hardware, bei Testeinsätzen an der Strecke oder im Werk München – stets mit Fokus auf die Digitalisierung und einen reibungslosen Datenaustausch unserer Ingenieure:innen an der Strecke und in München.

[Was erwartet dich?] Du unterstützt unser Elektronik-Team bei der technischen Entwicklung mit Toolchains und Plugins für Postprocessing und Synchronisierung für die Aktivitäten der Werksteams von BMW Motorrad Motorsport. • Außerdem wirkst du mit bei der Festlegung von IT-Hardware-Systemen zur dynamischen Datenübertragung von Rennstrecken weltweit ins BMW Netzwerk unter Berücksichtigung unseres Datensicherheits-Konzeptes. • Darüber hinaus unterstützt du bei der Dokumentation und Ausarbeitung von Software-Tools und IT-Systemen. • Zudem bist du bei kleineren Optimierungsprojekten eingebunden und hilfst mit bei der Integration von KI-Ansätzen in unserer Datenablage. • Außerdem unterstützt du im operativen Tagesgeschäft rund um Elektrik und Elektronik, Funktionsentwicklung sowie Datenanalyse. •

[Was bringst du mit?] Studium der Informatik oder Ingenieurswissenschaften, idealerweise mit dem Schwerpunkt IT-Systeme, praktische Informatik, technische Informatik oder vergleichbar. • Grundkenntnisse in cloudbasierten Datenbanken, VPN-Verbindungen, Mess-Clients, Multi-Netzwerk-Verbindungen, DHCP-Server, Fortigate Firewall. • Versierter Umgang mit Microsoft Tools, C++, Matlab, Python-Skripten, Linux Betriebssystem. • Eigeninitiative sowie Zielstrebigkeit. • Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit. • Führerscheinklasse B wünschenswert. • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. • Hast du Spaß daran, Neues zu lernen und unsere Abteilung tatkräftig zu unterstützen? jobs.title: Thesis on AI-Driven Map Matching and Path Prediction on Semantically Enriched Road Networks
jobs.description_text:
[What awaits you?] You will support modeling road connectivity and constraints in RDF and implementing rule sets to compute the most probable path using a rule-based reasoner. • Furthermore, you help build features from observations and the road graph, learning graph embeddings and training models to predict the next link or path. • In addition, you contribute to formulating path prediction as a reinforcement learning problem, integrating graph embeddings and training agents such as DQN or actor-critic. • Moreover, you will assist in developing sequence-to-sequence or transformer-based models to align GPS trajectories to graph-aligned edge sequences and comparing them to baselines. • Darüber hinaus wirkst du mit beim Experimentieren mit graph-aware attention or constrained decoding to inject RDF structure and semantics into learning models. • Additionally, you support designing metrics and scenarios, measuring accuracy, robustness, efficiency, and interpretability, and running ablations on embeddings and semantic attributes. •

[What should you bring along?] Studies in computer science, data science, electrical engineering or a related field. • Solid background in machine learning, including supervised learning and basic reinforcement learning. • Experience with Python and machine learning or deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, plus data processing libraries. • Familiarity with graph representations and knowledge graphs such as RDF and SPARQL; comfort with graph or knowledge graph embeddings is a plus. • Understanding of graph neural networks or representation learning methods. • Software engineering skills for reproducible experiments, including version control, clean code, and benchmarking. • Good German and English skills. • You are enthused by new technologies and an innovative environment? Then Apply now!

[What do we offer?] Comprehensive mentoring & onboarding. • Personal & professional development. • Flexible working hours. • Mobile work. • Attractive & fair compensation. • Student apartments (subject to availability & only at the Munich location). • And much more, see bmw.jobs/whatweoffer •

[Start date] earliest start 05/15/2026

[Duration] 6 months

[Working hours] Full-time You can find helpful tips on your application and the application process here . At the BMW Group, we place great importance on equal treatment and equal opportunities. Our recruiting decisions are based on the personality, experience, and skills of the applicants. Learn more here .

sections_raw.Was erwartet dich?: Du unterstützt in den frühen Phasen von Exterior User Interface Konzepten und wirkst mit bei der Erkundung neuer Technologien. • Außerdem hilfst du bei praktischen Prototypen sowie konzeptionellen und theoretischen Aufgaben. • Darüber hinaus trägst du zu kreativen Design-Herausforderungen bei und unterstützt bei routinemäßigen Tätigkeiten, um Projekte voranzubringen. • Zudem wirkst du mit beim Fahren von Prototypen zwischen BMW Standorten und erledigst wiederkehrende Aufgaben zuverlässig. • Du unterstützt bei der eigenständigen Bearbeitung von Aufgaben und erhältst regelmäßig Feedback von deiner Ansprechperson. •
sections_raw.Was bringst du mit?: Studium des Ingenieurwesens, Industriedesigns oder vergleichbar. • Verständnis und Erfahrung im Prototyping mit Arduino, ESP32 oder ähnlichen Plattformen. • Fähigkeit, kreative Aufgaben zu unterstützen und wiederkehrende Tätigkeiten präzise zu erledigen. • Teamfähigkeit sowie Bereitschaft, Aufgaben proaktiv und mit Initiative voranzubringen. • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. • Möchtest du die Zukunft der Fahrzeuginteraktion mitgestalten und wertvolle Erfahrungen sammeln? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!
sections_raw.Was bieten wir dir?: Umfassendes Mentoring & Onboarding. • Persönliche & fachliche Weiterentwicklung. • Flexible Arbeitszeiten. • Mobilarbeit. • Attraktive & faire Vergütung. • Apartments für Studierende (nach Verfügbarkeit & nur am Standort München). • Und vieles mehr siehe bmw.jobs/waswirbieten •

jobs.title: Intern LLM-enhanced in-vehicle personal assistants (f/m/x)
jobs.description_text:
[What awaits you?] You will support core development activities using Python, incorporating LLM libraries and Pydantic for enhanced functionality. • Furthermore, you contribute to the platform across multiple programming languages and frameworks, including Android Automotive and Azure Pub/Sub. • In addition, you help solve complex problems and devise innovative solutions to enhance the MLLM capabilities of our in-vehicle personal assistant. • Moreover, you will assist in planning and executing user studies with prototypes to validate concepts. •

[What should you bring along?] Studies in computer science, media informatics or a related field. • Strong proficiency in Python. • Experience with Android development using Kotlin or Java. • Knowledge and experience with Azure or other cloud platform deployments integrating with CI/CD tools like Git. • Experience in developing large language models; experience with multimodal LLMs is a plus and experience with user-centered development and conducting user studies, ideally in voice user interfaces or automotive applications. • Ability to collaborate in research and development teams, contributing innovative ideas. • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in German is a plus. • Would you like to shape the future of in-vehicle personal assistants with cutting-edge AI technology? Then Apply now!

[What do we offer?] Comprehensive mentoring & onboarding. • Personal & professional development. • Flexible working hours. • Mobile work. • Attractive & fair compensation. • Apartments for students (subject to availability & only at the Munich location). • And much more, see bmw.jobs/whatweoffer •

[Start date] earliest start 01.06.2026

[Duration] 5 months

[Working hours] Full-time You can find helpful tips on your application and the application process here . At the BMW Group, we place great importance on equal treatment and equal opportunities. Our recruiting decisions are based on the personality, experience, and skills of the applicants. Learn more here .

jobs.title: Werkstudent User Interface & User Experience - Prototyping, Tooling, Methodik (w/m/x)
jobs.start_info: Startdatum: frühestens ab 01.06.2026 | Dauer: 12 Monate | Arbeitszeit: Teilzeit
jobs.description_text:
[intro] Unser UI/UX Team bei der BMW Group konzentriert sich auf Prototyping inklusive Fahrsimulationsumgebung. Wir betreuen die Simulationsumgebung und kooperieren eng mit verschiedenen Entwicklungsteams, um innovative Nutzererlebnisse zu schaffen.

[Was erwartet dich?] Du unterstützt bei UI/UX Themen rund um die Sitzkiste und die Fahrsimulationsumgebung. • Außerdem wirkst du mit bei der Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung von Fahrsimulations- und Erprobungsszenarien. • Darüber hinaus unterstützt du bei Dokumentation und methodischem Arbeiten, zum Beispiel bei Versuchsaufbauten, Abläufen und Ergebnissen. • Zudem trägst du zur engen Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Teams, Gewerken und Schnittstellen innerhalb der Entwicklung bei. • Du hilfst beim Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Tools und Systemen im UI/UX Umfeld. • Außerdem unterstützt du beim schnellen Einarbeiten in neue Themen sowie beim flexiblen Mitwirken in einem dynamischen Arbeitsumfeld. • Du wirkst mit beim Einsatz und der Erprobung moderner KI-basierter Tools zur Unterstützung von UI/UX Aufgaben. •

[Was bringst du mit?] Studium der Informatik, Medieninformatik oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs. • Interesse an User Interface, User Experience und Fahrsimulations- beziehungsweise Entwicklungsumgebungen. • Grundkenntnisse in JavaScript sowie Python von Vorteil. • Erste Berührungspunkte mit ARP- oder UI-nahen Technologien wünschenswert. • Erfahrung oder Interesse im Umgang mit KI-Tools. • Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie Freude am Netzwerken. • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. • Du bringst Begeisterung für neue Technologien und ein innovatives Umfeld mit? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!

[Was bieten wir dir?] Umfassendes Mentoring & Onboarding. • Persönliche & fachliche Weiterentwicklung. • Flexible Arbeitszeiten. • Mobilarbeit. • Attraktive & faire Vergütung. • Apartments für Studierende (nach Verfügbarkeit & nur am Standort München). • Und vieles mehr siehe bmw.jobs/waswirbieten •

[Startdatum] frühestens ab 01.06.2026

[Dauer] 12 Monate

[Arbeitszeit] Teilzeit Hilfreiche Tipps zu deiner Bewerbung und dem Bewerbungsprozess findest du hier . Wir bei der BMW Group legen großen Wert auf Gleichbehandlung und Chancengleichheit. Unsere Recruiting-Entscheidungen basieren auf der Persönlichkeit, den Erfahrungen und Fähigkeiten der Bewerber:innen. Mehr dazu hier .
